author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
If Anthropic really worries about AI is getting out of control, here is a simple solution.  

They just need to open source their best frontier model, so no one else will have any financial incentive to build an even better model.  Everyone will focus on cost optimization of the best model instead.

Anthropic can sacrifice itself to save the humanity if it really believes in its own words, not just trying to pump the IPO.
